draft.emotion: satisfied and content, like finishing a good meal or a long task
notes: When saying what something is full of, the noun that follows takes the genitive case (e.g., 'pełna wody').
Has a short masculine predicative form 'pełen' used before a noun in the genitive (e.g., 'kosz pełen jabłek' — a basket full of apples).
Do not confuse with 'cały' (whole, entire). Also, for being full after eating, use 'najedzony' or 'syty', not 'pełny'.
